expectation: Membrane ring on myeloid cells (monocytes, macrophages, MDSCs, some DCs). Scattered single cells or loose clusters in stroma and around tumour nests, a minority of cells, distinct from neighbours. Not a tissue-wide sheet.
notes: CD33 looks like a tissue-wide haze. Brightness changes from image to image and follows the fibre texture, not single cells. Even the brightest spot (D) is a diffuse sheet around nuclei, not membrane rings. Only a few isolated yellow dots look cell-like.
observed: A: tiles vary a lot in overall intensity, and many show diffuse yellow that follows stroma or fibre texture. B, C: grain, a few small bright specks, no ringed cells. D: a broad yellow sheet wrapping several nuclei, no discrete membrane rings. No row E.
why: The signal is diffuse, tracks the tissue texture and changes from image to image, with no distinct ringed myeloid subset at any scale.
